content: Authoritative source inputs should be separated into the 2026-28 EURO regulations and Annex A calendar, UEFA's EURO 2028 qualification-system announcement and draw announcement, and post-draw UEFA competition pages or exports for status, groups, fixtures, standings, and results. The 2026/27 Nations League regulations Articles 15, 16, and 19 plus Phase 15's accepted outcome bundle supply the cross-competition eligibility lineage. UEFA pages are authoritative but page paths and rendered data are operationally volatile, so retain raw snapshots, URLs, retrieval time, hashes, parser version, and fallback metadata.
